description: This source file defines the AuditableInterceptor class, a Hibernate interceptor that automatically sets auditing fields (such as creator, dateCreated, changedBy, dateChanged) on OpenMRS objects when they are saved or updated in the database. It handles setting these fields for insertion and update events, as well as collection changes related to user roles.

classes.name: AuditableInterceptor
classes.description: A Hibernate interceptor class that sets auditing fields on OpenMRS objects during database operations.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Called when saving a new entity, sets creator and dateCreated if they are null.

methods.name: onFlushDirty
methods.description: Called when an existing entity is updated, sets changedBy and dateChanged fields.

methods.name: onCollectionRecreate
methods.description: Handles collection creation events, triggers collection change handling logic.

methods.name: onCollectionUpdate
methods.description: Handles collection update events, triggers collection change handling logic.

methods.name: onCollectionRemove
methods.description: Handles collection removal events, triggers collection change handling logic.

methods.name: setCreatorAndDateCreatedIfNull
methods.description: Sets creator and dateCreated fields if they are null, when inserting new objects.

methods.name: changeProperties
methods.description: Helper method to update properties in the entity state.

methods.name: getPropertyValuesToSave
methods.description: Returns a map of properties to set when creating a new object (creator, dateCreated, etc).

methods.name: getPropertyValuesToUpdate
methods.description: Returns a map of properties to set when updating an object (changedBy, dateChanged, etc).

methods.name: changePropertyValue
methods.description: Sets a specific property to a new value if conditions match.

methods.name: handleCollectionChange
methods.description: Handles changes in collections, specifically user roles, to update related auditing fields.
